Team / Emma —

We're in the 48-hour window before EOQ close and a few accounts sit on the borderline of commit vs. commit-with-conditions. I pulled a working sheet and annotated what I think are the bridge items; attaching EOQ_commit_rollup_v3.xlsx. High level asks: 1) please update the "stage" column to either COMMIT / COMMIT-PENDING-PO / AT-RISK with a one-line rationale, 2) for COMMIT-PENDING-PO add expected PO date, and 3) if you are relying on finance exceptions or credits note the approver.

Marissa — can you sweep the list and flag any deals where ACV or term changes are expected? Ben — call out any outstanding procurement blockers. Laura — I'll need final revenue impact numbers by EOD tomorrow for forecasting. Emma (Nimbus) — if we can get a PO date for the line items with "pending" status it will clear the book on our side.

Quick notes in the sheet: red rows = needs legal/discount signoff, yellow = PO pending, green = clean commit. I will consolidate and circulate a single-line rollup every 12 hours until close.

Thanks —
